content: निवृत्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Returning or coming back, return; दुर्गमेकमपुनर्निवृत्तये यं विशन्ति वशिनं मुमुक्षवः <ls>Śi. 14. 64</ls>; <ls>R. 4. 87</ls>. .²2 Disappearance, cessation, termination, suspension; शापनिवृत्तौ <ls>Ś. 7</ls>; <ls>R. 8. 82</ls>. .²3 Abstaining from work, inactivity (<ab>opp.</ab> प्रवृत्ति); प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः <ls>Bg. 16. 7</ls>. .²4 Abstaining from, aversion; प्राणाघातान्निवृत्तिः <ls>Bh. 3. 63</ls>. .²5 Leaving off, desisting from. .²6 Resignation, discontinuance of worldly acts or emotions, quietism, separation from the world. .²7 Repose, rest. .²8 Felicity, beatitude. .²9 Denial, refusal. .²10 Abolition, prevention. .²11 Ceasing to be valid or binding (as a rule.). .²12 Completion. .²13 (In drama.)
